digest.component_or_area: Plan review gate T1 (overlay-priorart) — web search capability routing
propositions: Bedrock cutover removed T1's server-side web-search tool via provider-name prefix gate (resolved.startswith('anthropic') now fails for bedrock:-qualified Claude), silencing a blocking criterion's grounding capability
T1 is a BLOCKING criterion declared to require web access but now runs without it on Bedrock due to prefix routing that contradicts the epic's zero-exceptions rule against provider-name matching
provider_provenance.capabilities does not record web-access attachment state, making silent withdrawal impossible to detect in signed verdicts

Web-search capability decision must derive from model profile/registry membership (native_web_search) not provider-name prefix, with fallback to local duckduckgo tool where provider lacks native support
T1's prompt must assert web access as guaranteed rather than optional, while maintaining anti-fabrication constraints on untrusted fetched content
